name: BookOrbit
description: Your self-hosted library for ebooks, audiobooks, comics and PDFs.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, covers, cache, Book Dock, conversion files, secret keys and settings.

paths.name: Books
paths.description: Your book files - EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, PDF, CBZ/CBR comics and M4B/MP3 audiobooks. Point it at your own books folder if you have one.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: BookOrbit web app, API, OPDS and Kobo/KOReader sync, published on host as 6124

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open BookOrbit at, like http://your-server-ip:6124. Links in emails, Kobo sync and OPDS use it. Change localhost to your server IP, or to your own domain if you put BookOrbit behind HTTPS.
